breakdown.description: For curved submerged surfaces, the horizontal component equals the hydrostatic force on the vertical projection (not the horizontal projection).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification states the horizontal force is computed using the 'horizontal projection' area, repeating the original error. The ground truth requires using the VERTICAL projection for the horizontal force component.

breakdown.description: The vertical component is obtained from the weight of the fluid volume above the surface, not from projecting the area in the same way as the horizontal component.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification computes the vertical component by multiplying pressure at the centroid of the 'vertical projection' by its area. The ground truth requires computing the vertical component as the weight of the imaginary column of water above the curved surface up to the free surface, not via a projection-area method.
